title: 3Sum
description: Find all unique triplets that sum to zero using sorting and two pointers.

data.text: Given an integer array `nums`, return all unique triplets `[nums[i], nums[j], nums[k]]` such that `i != j != k` and `nums[i] + nums[j] + nums[k] == 0`.

data.title: Brute Force O(n³)

data.text: Sort, then fix one element and search for the remaining two with two pointers. O(n²) time, O(1) extra space.

data.title: Two Pointers O(n²)

data.caption: After sorting, fix one element and move two pointers inward to find pairs that sum to the negative of the fixed element.
data.definition:
graph TB
    A[Sorted: -4 -1 -1 0 1 2] --> B[Fix i=1 value=-1]
    B --> C[left=2 right=5]
    C --> D[sum=-1+-1+2=0 match]
    D --> E[left=3 right=4]
    E --> F[sum=-1+0+1=0 match]
    F --> G[left=4 right=3 stop]
    style D fill:#e8f5e9,stroke:#2e7d32
    style F fill:#e8f5e9,stroke:#2e7d32

data.title: What improved?
data.text: **Time:** O(n³) → O(n²). **Space:** O(1) extra. Sorting removes duplicates for free and lets two pointers find pairs in linear time per fixed element.
